summary_1line: Ghatotkacha devastates Kaurava warriors and charges at Duryodhana until Bhima and Pandava forces rush in, triggering a chaotic, dust-choked massacre.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha rises into the sky roaring like thunder while surrounded by arrows raining from Kaurava warriors below.
Bhima and a host of Pandava warriors charge across the trembling battlefield with elephants and chariots to rescue Ghatotkacha.
A dust-choked battlefield where warriors cannot recognize friend from foe as severed heads and shattered chariots lie amid a river of blood.
